questions.stem: — What did he say just now? — He said that he ____ busy then.

options.distractor: 主句是过去时，从句要退成 was
主句是过去时，不能用将来时
主句是过去时，要用 had been

questions.stem: The geography teacher said that the sun ____ in the east.

options.distractor: 客观真理永远用一般现在时
客观真理用一般现在时

questions.stem: He asked me where I ____ the day before.

options.distractor: 主句是过去时，从句要退成过去时
主句是过去时，不能用将来时
要用过去完成时 had gone

questions.stem: She says that she ____ to Beijing twice.

options.distractor: 主句是现在时，从句不需要退时态
twice 表示经历，用现在完成时
twice 表示已发生的经历

questions.explanation: 主句是现在时，从句按需要用现在完成时。

options.text: He told me he would visit the museum the next day.
The teacher said practice makes perfect.
options.distractor: 正确：谚语/真理用现在时

options.text: She said she has seen the film before.
We knew that he was ill.

questions.explanation: 主句是过去时，应改为 she had seen the film before。

questions.stem: — Did Mr Li tell you ____? — Yes, he said the earth is round.

options.distractor: 主句是过去时，从句要退时态

questions.explanation: what he said（陈述语序 + 过去时）。
